dataset: Official GroupLens MovieLens 1M, 1,000,209 explicit ratings. Research use only. No raw data redistribution.
split: Per user, sort distinct rating timestamps. Earliest 70% timestamp groups train, next 15% validation, remaining groups test. No timestamp group crosses a boundary. Users with fewer than 3 timestamp groups remain training-only.
evaluation_eligibility: At least five training positives and at least one positive in validation and test. Eligibility is fixed before scoring. All catalogue items are candidates except previously rated items.
temporal_limit: Per-user chronological holdout, not a globally chronological deployment simulation. Another user's training event can be later than a query user's holdout event. Catalogue assumed fixed and available. Ratings do not establish actual watch order or exposure.
validation_users: Up to 1024 eligible users, seeded sample, seed 42
final_test_users: All eligible users. No sampled-negative test ranking.
selection: Choose learned checkpoint by validation NDCG@20. Select genre blending weight on validation, then choose the overall recommendation from all model candidates using validation NDCG@20. Save selection before test scoring. No test retuning or final refit.
inference: Paired bootstrap over eligible users, 10000 resamples, seed 42, for selected model minus popularity in NDCG@20. One training seed only.
limits: Old research dataset. Static catalogue. Offline explicit-rating positives, not online clicks or satisfaction. No A/B test or production impact claim. No demographic features used.
